results.previousDetail: Is Renewal node tech says 'NULL result is not considered true and the row goes to Not Renewal'. The DTSX sets errorRowDisposition="FailComponent" on the Renewal output; in SSIS a Conditional Split condition that evaluates to NULL is an error handled by that disposition (FailComponent -> component and data flow fail; only IgnoreFailure would treat it as False). So a matched active POA with NULL agentcyIdNumberPa fails the data flow rather than reaching Update NeedToSendMailBit (mapping-A states this correctly, as hypothesis per SSIS semantics). Same omission for AppendixType: its condition gen_appendixtype == 2 || == 3 || == 5 has FailComponent disposition, so a waiting POA with NULL gen_appendixtype fails the flow (after its SQL UPDATE already executed) instead of going to 'No Email' as the 'else' branch implies. Everything else in the component (population, 6 excluded ids, NOT IN dropping NULL ids, Lookup keys, letter versions 1/2, No Email values, staging destination) verified.
